module.interface: YfinanceChecker(*, history=None, sleep=time.sleep, clock=time.monotonic, cap=10, pace_seconds=1.0).check(symbols) -> {SYMBOL: {state, rows, last_close, reason}}; default_history(symbol) -> [(date_iso, close)] or raises; CheckerUnavailable, ErrorFrame
module.behaviour: symbols upper-cased and de-duplicated in order; a symbol failing the estate's SYMBOL pattern (security_resolution.py:17) or not a str is NOT_CHECKED with SYMBOL_REFUSED before any call and does not use the cap; the first cap=10 accepted distinct symbols are called in order with one history call each, sleep(pace_seconds) before every call except the first; the rest are NOT_CHECKED BEYOND_CAP; a PUSHBACK (401/403/429-shaped) stops the step and every later symbol is NOT_CHECKED STEP_STOPPED; KEPT needs rows > 0 and a finite positive last close; a clean empty list is NOT_KEPT NO_ROWS; a non-finite or non-positive last close is NOT_KEPT; an exception is CHECK_FAILED with reason EXCEPTION, TIMEOUT (TimeoutError or a timeout-shaped name or text), PUSHBACK, or ERROR_FRAME (ErrorFrame, raised by the default port when an empty frame carries a yfinance error entry, or when no error signal can be observed). CheckerUnavailable propagates out of check() as a configuration fault.
